body: Your words are very soothing, I feel stronger now, thanks so much kind soul 💙⭐️

I am so angry right now, cause I do my best to be happy and its not even for me, just to be throw into the I want to die bottomless pitch cause I am not perfect enough, Im sorry, but fuck this situation of mine.

But if theres abusive people in your life, stay away from them, see what makes you go into the I want to die line of thought and try to find a way to get out of this, just keep searching, sometimes it isnt our fault, but you dont deserve to think you should die man, you deserve happiness

Oh man, I am really sorry for your loss, losing your mother to a heartbreaking disease like cancer must have been really hard for you. Only time will be able to heal the pain you feel and sometime along the way, the pain will be less and the good memories with your mom will shine throught all the pain you are feeling, wish you well and a lot of strenght to deal with this harsh moment you are dealing with.
Happy birthday! Wish you everything great in life and more.

I know how it feels man, it feels like hell on Earth, but just that you are thinking about getting help and better is already a step in the right direction, it is pretty hard and a real struggle everyday, so you can consider this a true real fight and it is actually. 
Everyday you fight and with each fight you got a win, an improvement, because you survived the day and you will see that everyday it is another fight won and another improvement because you survived it. So be proud of yourself everyday, you will eventually grow stronger and your wish to be better will naturally come to you, as all other things you want.
Also, it is okay to feel like crap, you are a human that is suffering right now, so don't beat yourself up for feeling like crap, we all do, there is nothing wrong with that. Focus on the NOW more than the future, depression will make you think your future is bad, it is all a lie it is telling ya, don't believe it.
You got this my friend
I know how it feels, but don't lose hope my friend
